items.title: Michael Pittman: Full practice Wednesday
items.text:

items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling: Not yet close to return
items.text:
San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that Stribling (ankle) is likely at least "a couple weeks away" from returning to practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. "I don't know. I mean, nothing's changed," Shanahan said, regarding a timeline for the rookie receiver.
